name: Chapter 3 - Import Session Proposals from Excel
brief: Imports approved session proposals from Excel with AI-assisted column mapping, Regenerate, and history of generations.
description: Chapter 3 demo - Import approved session proposals from Excel. User attaches an Excel file; the copilot helps map Excel headers to BC table fields and imports session proposals into custom tables. Introduces Attach, mapping, Regenerate, and history of generations.
